use_of_test: second evaluation of this project on the OpenOOD v1.5 ImageNet-1K test split; the first (test_eval/prereg_test.json) evaluated CLAVIS
written_before: any CLAVIS-M score on the test split is computed
run_condition: the frozen candidate passed the stopping rule of iter/prereg_iter.json on dev1 and on dev2 (dev2 look 1 of at most 3); run exactly once (the script refuses a second run)
features: test_eval/results/features.pt stored by the first evaluation (DINOv2 ViT-B/14 CLS of 12,000 support + 4,000 calibration shots + all test images; CLIP zero-shot top-5 candidates); no test image is re-read
tins: S_final of Codex's unchanged-upstream reproduction (scores_openood_*.npz), stream seed 123, batch 256; the memory follows the same stream order and batches and is reset for every ID+OOD stream
report: AUROC and FPR95 (Codex's convention and upstream) per dataset and near/far means for TINS, CLAVIS, CLAVIS-M_c1 and the visual score g alone; no other variant is evaluated on the test
then: stop the improvement loop and report whatever the result
